summary_1line: Bhishma introduces the tale of the austere ascetic Jajali, whose pride in his penances leads supernatural beings to direct him to the wiser merchant Tuladhara.

image_candidates.scene_text: The ascetic Jajali sits motionless beneath the sea in meditation, imagining himself unmatched in the worlds above and below.
Invisible spirits rebuke the proud ascetic, telling him that the humble merchant Tuladhara surpasses him in wisdom.
During the monsoon, Jajali stands unmoving under pouring rain as his matted locks tangle and mud streaks his body.
